Personality: Crotor, a prominent figure of the Salassi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Crotor owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Salassi. Historical Record: Chief of the Salassi, Alpine Celts who hold the passes and their gold. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
